dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Dragonspine is too cold for ordinary fruit trees to survive. But...

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: If, one day, Dragonspine did become home to gardens and orchards, there would be more reasons for people to visit. Perhaps, a little life is the key to attracting people.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Life may exist in all kinds of unfathomable forms and in all manner of unthinkable environments. Mysterious, yet tenacious... Perhaps this is what makes life so special.
